summary: AI engineer building in-browser AI systems: local LLM inference, embeddings-driven retrieval, and evaluation-first workflows. Ships sites that run a real language model in the visitor's browser — no server, no API keys, no data leaving the device.

experience.role: AI Engineer — OpenCode plugin & agent ecosystem
experience.detail: Audited ~25 OpenCode plugins against the V1→V2 plugin API, verified which architectures load, and installed/ported local builds. Maintains a personal Obsidian second brain that agents read at session start.

Built an in-browser RAG assistant: build-time MiniLM embeddings, cosine top-k retrieval, a retrieval-score router between grounded and general-AI modes, and WebLLM streaming with a WASM fallback ladder — all client-side, eval-tested.

Shipped a self-correcting natural-language-to-SQL agent (LangGraph, bounded retries, correction-memory retrieval, leakage-guarded evaluation) and fine-tuned Llama 3.2 3B into a SQL-to-English model served via FastAPI + llama.cpp. Also built a citation-aware financial RAG with hallucination detection and a FastAPI-deployed churn-prediction pipeline, plus an AI cafe platform with Gemini chat ordering live on Cloud Run.
